turquois.definition:
n. A hydrous phosphate of alumina containing a little
   copper; calaite. It has a blue, or bluish green, color, and usually
   occurs in reniform masses with a botryoidal surface.
turquois.translation:
n. 绿松石, 青绿色
a. 青绿色的

turquoise.definition: n. a blue to grey green mineral consisting of copper aluminum phosphate
turquoise.translation: n. 绿松石, 绿松石色

turquoises.definition:
n. a blue to grey green mineral consisting of copper aluminum phosphate
n. a shade of blue tinged with green
turquoises.translation: n. 绿松石( turquoise的复数形式 ); 青绿色
